attributes.title: 2027 Colorado Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Colorado Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Colorado Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting on Friday and Saturday, February 5 and 6, 2027, at The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs. It can also be followed online through selected live keynote and education sessions.

The agenda covers updates in medicine, coronary CT and calcium scoring, vaccines, osteoporosis, menopause and lipid management, plus workshops and resident presentations. ACP designates the meeting for up to 10 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and 10 ABIM MOC points.

In-person registration is $375 for ACP members and $450 for non-member physicians through January 8, 2027, then $400 and $500. Resident and student members pay $35, then $40. Virtual attendance is $199 for members and $250 for non-member physicians, rising to $299 and $350. The Broadmoor room block is held until January 1, 2027.
